summary: Licence flow-down obligation from the MiniMax H3 authorization needs a user consent gate in front of a licence-gated model download. Blocks shipping H3; does not block MPI-449 bench research.

Generalised from an H3-only consent gate to a reusable licence-gate system driven by a ModelDef descriptor; Flux named as the next consumer. Design settled: territory-restricted licences route the user to the licensor's own authorization form rather than disclaiming responsibility onto them. Marked as blocking MPI-452.

todo -> doing. Gate hooks downloadService.start() (five install call sites, one chokepoint); non-gated models keep the synchronous download:started emit MpiModelManager._install depends on. Descriptors in js/data/modelConstants/licences.js keyed by model id, not on the ModelDef. Scroll-to-bottom gates the Use Restrictions + Exhibit A pane; the full 17KB agreement is a link out. Discord is the misuse-reporting route.
